It is also written as “Take Okami Shrine” (太祁於賀美神社), and enshrines {{ill|Kuraokami|de|Kuraokami|it|Kuraokami|ja|淤加美神|sv|Okami-no-Kami|zh|闇淤加美神|qid=Q644201|lt=Takaokami no Kami}} (a water deity).

== History ==
This shrine appears in the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}} as “Ōke Okami Shrine, Ishikawa District, {{ill|Kawachi Province|be|Каваты (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Kawachi|ckb|پارێزگای کاواچی|cs|Provincie Kawači|de|Provinz Kawachi|es|Provincia de Kawachi|fa|ولایت کاواچی|fr|Province de Kawachi|gl|Provincia de Kawachi|hak|Kawachi-koet|id|Provinsi Kawachi|it|Kawachi (provincia)|ja|河内国|ko|가와치국|lt|Kavačio žemė|nl|Kawachi (provincie)|pt|Província de Kawachi|ru|Кавати (провинция)|simple|Kawachi Province|sk|Kawači (provincia)|sr|Провинција Кавачи|tr|Kawachi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Каваті|zh|河內國|zh_min_nan|Kawati-kok|zh_yue|河內國|qid=Q1047150}}{{ill|Ishikawa district|ja|石川郡 (大阪府)|zh|石川郡 (大阪府)|qid=Q11586399|lt=Ishikawa District}},” but it is not found in the {{ill|Rikkokushi|cs|Rikkokuši|de|Rikkokushi|es|Rikkokushi|eu|Rikkokushi|fa|شش تاریخ ملی|fr|Rikkokushi|it|Rikkokushi|ja|六国史|ko|육국사|pt|Rikkokushi|ru|Риккокуси|simple|Rikkokushi|zh|六國史|qid=Q1151168|lt=Six National Histories}}, and its history before the Edo period is unknown. Both the former and current shrine sites were within old {{ill|Furuichi district|ja|古市郡|zh|古市郡|qid=Q11411239}}, but that reflects district-boundary changes after the Engishiki period.

Originally the shrine stood on a hill summit east of the current site, and until the Edo period it was called {{ill|Sannō Gongen|ja|山王権現|zh|山王權現|qid=Q11470054}} (even now, parishioners call it “Sannō Gongen”). The 1801 ({{ill|Kyōwa|de|Kyōwa (Ära)|fa|کیووا|fr|Ère Kyōwa|ja|享和|ko|교와|ru|Кёва (нэнго)|simple|Kyōwa|sr|Кјова|sv|Kyōwa|tr|Kyōwa|zh|享和|qid=Q960763}} 1) work ''{{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kawachi Meisho Zue}}'' says: “Listed under Ishikawa District in the Engishiki. Now called Sannō and revered as the tutelary deity of this place.” In the early Meiji period it became a village shrine, but on November 18, 1907 (Meiji 40), it was merged ({{ill|Shrine Consolidation Policy|fr|Politique de consolidation des sanctuaires|ja|神社合祀|simple|Shrine Consolidation Policy|zh|神社合祀|qid=Q11590700|lt=gōshi}}) into nearby village-shrine Hachiman Shrine (now {{ill|Tsuboi Hachimangū|fr|Tsuboi Hachiman-gū|ja|壺井八幡宮|my|ဆွတ်ဘိုအိဟချိမန်းဂူး|qid=Q11429677}}).

At the request of former parishioners, it was rebuilt on December 1, 1955 ({{ill|1955|ab|1955|af|1955|als|1955|am|1955 እ.ኤ.አ.|an|1955|ar|1955|ary|1955|arz|1955|ast|1955|av|1955|avk|1955|az|1955|azb|۱۹۵۵ (میلادی)|ba|1955 йыл|ban|1955|bat_smg|1955|bcl|1955|be|1955|be_x_old|1955|bg|1955|bh|1955|bjn|1955|bn|১৯৫৫|bpy|মারি ১৯৫৫|br|1955|bs|1955.|ca|1955|cbk_zam|1955|cdo|1955 nièng|ce|1955 шо|ceb|1955|ckb|١٩٥٥|co|1955|crh|1955|cs|1955|csb|1955|cv|1955|cy|1955|da|1955|de|1955|diq|1955|dsb|1955|el|1955|eml|1955|eo|1955|es|1955|et|1955|eu|1955|fa|۱۹۵۵|fi|1955|fiu_vro|1955|fo|1955|fr|1955|frp|1955|frr|1955|fur|1955|fy|1955|ga|1955|gag|1955|gan|1955年|gcr|1955|gd|1955|gl|1955|gn|1955|gv|1955|hak|1955-ngièn|he|1955|hi|१९५५|hif|1955|hr|1955.|hsb|1955|ht|1955 (almanak gregoryen)|hu|1955|hy|1955|hyw|1955 թուական|ia|1955|id|1955|ie|1955|ilo|1955|inh|1955 шу|io|1955|is|1955|it|1955|ja|1955年|jbo|1955moi|jv|1955|ka|1955|kaa|1955|kbp|1955|kk|1955 жыл|kn|೧೯೫೫|ko|1955년|krc|1955 джыл|ksh|Joohr 1955|ku|1955|kv|1955-ӧд во|kw|1955|la|1955|lb|1955|lez|1955 йис|li|1955|lij|1955|lld|1955|lmo|1955|ln|1955|lt|1955 m.|lv|1955. gads|mai|१९५५|map_bms|1955|mdf|1955|mg|1955|mhr|1955|mi|1955|min|1955|mk|1955|ml|1955|mn|1955 он|mr|इ.स. १९५५|mrj|1955 и|ms|1955|my|၁၉၅၅|myv|1955 ие|mzn|۱۹۵۵|nah|1955|nap|1955|nds|1955|nds_nl|1955|nl|1955|nn|1955|no|1955|nov|1955|nrm|1955|nso|1955|oc|1955|olo|1955|or|୧୯୫୫|os|1955-æм аз|pa|1955|pam|1955|pap|1955|pl|1955|pnb|1955|pt|1955|qu|1955|ro|1955|roa_tara|1955|ru|1955 год|rue|1955|sah|1955|sat|᱑᱙᱕᱕|sc|1955|scn|1955|sd|1955ع|se|1955|sh|1955.|shn|1955|si|1955|simple|1955|sk|1955|sl|1955|smn|1955|so|1955|sq|1955|sr|1955|stq|1955|su|1955|sv|1955|sw|1955|szl|1955|ta|1955|te|1955|tet|1955|tg|Соли 1955|th|พ.ศ. 2498|tk|1955|tl|1955|tly|1955|tpi|1955|tr|1955|tt|1955 ел|ty|1955|udm|1955 ар|ug|1955 - يىلى|uk|1955|ur|1955ء|uz|1955|vec|1955|vi|1955|vls|1955|vo|1955|wa|1955|war|1955|xmf|1955|yi|1955|za|1955 nienz|zea|1955|zh|1955年|zh_classical|一九五五年|zh_min_nan|1955 nî|zh_yue|1955年|qid=Q18577}}), borrowing land owned by {{ill|Daikoku-ji Temple|ja|大黒寺 (羽曳野市)|qid=Q17228997|lt=Daikoku-ji Temple}}.

After the merger, the former shrine site was sold and used for soil extraction, and the hill has nearly disappeared.
